notes: Added a visible Stock on Hand section in the Parts tab.
Each stocked part now shows quantity on hand, true cost per part, and total stock value.
RockAuto parts show landed per-unit cost so shipping, tax, and discount are included in future service cost.
Purchase inventory stays separate from maintenance history until the part is actually installed.
Future install workflow is documented: log the service at the install date/mileage, apply the stored part cost, then reduce stock quantity.
